narrative.details: When you fight the enemy, gather the scraps of their armor and bring them to me.  I'll use those scraps to make armor for our own troops!
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.
narrative.offerRewardText:
These will do nicely. I'll melt them down and patch them up and you'll never know they came from those Stormpike cowards!

Thanks, adventurer. And let me polish up that armor of yours...
narrative.requestItemsText: How goes the hunting, adventurer. Do you have any armor scraps for me?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 6,600 XP in all.
